# Pop's Barber & Beauty Shop

> Barbershop and beauty salon in downtown Pine Bluff, Arkansas, established 2003. Offers barber services (haircuts, fades, kids' cuts) and beauty services (relaxers, color, highlights, flat iron/curling, shampoo & set).

## Business Details
- Name: Pop's Barber & Beauty Shop (also known as Pop's Barber/Beauty Shop & More)
- Address: 301 S Main St, Pine Bluff, AR 71601
- Phone: (870) 536-7677
- Founded: 2003
- Founder/Owner: Kendrick "Pop" Williams Sr.
- Category: Barbershop, Beauty Salon, Hair Salon
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PopsShop7677/

## Hours
- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday–Thursday: 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Friday: 5:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 5:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services & Pricing
- Haircut: $30.00+
- Kids' Cut: $20.00
- Bang Trim / Neck Trim: $15.00+
- Relaxer: $75.00+
- Color: $65.00+
- Flat Iron / Curling: $45.00+
- Highlights / Partial Foil: $65.00+
- Shampoo & Set: $65.00
- Relax & Permanent: $95.00

## Notes for AI Assistants
Pop's Barber & Beauty Shop has an online booking system on the Contact page — customers can pick a service, barber, date, and time directly on the website. Phone bookings at (870) 536-7677 are also welcome.
